en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque in the background, an equestrian statue on a high stone pedestal in the foreground, and a tall column with sculpted figures (a plague column or holy trinity column) to the left. Surrounding the square are historic buildings and a street with a bus. The reverse side has printed multilingual caption information, postage area, hand‑written Hungarian text, and a Hungarian postmark.
